# The meadow: a 19 x 19 m slab, its top textured from above (textures/meadow.png, drawn by
# make_env.py). Only the top is kept: the camera never sees the sides. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Meadow --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Ground --size 1 --location 0 4.5 -0.3
scale 19 19 0.6
apply --scale
active Ground
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Meadow
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Meadow base-color textures/meadow.png
select all
shade flat
export ground.glb
